summary_paragraph: A male patient with a history of liver transplant presented with nausea, vomiting, and headache for approximately 20 hours. He was admitted for observation and found to be dehydrated but otherwise stable. Imaging showed no intracranial abnormality, bowel obstruction, or pneumonia, and a spinal tap revealed no infection. He was managed with IV fluids and continued on his home immunosuppressive and supportive medications. His symptoms resolved overnight, and he tolerated a regular diet by morning. He was discharged home in improved condition with instructions to resume normal activities and return if symptoms recurred.
